selection: Huge BROWN cosmetic cloud follows behind hero for full8seconds and spans water-to-top gameplay height.
source_preservation: Reuse existing approved PNG unchanged; preserve native partial alpha, no hard scissor.
ordinary_fidget: Existing ordinary cloud and small bubble effect remain independent; do not change their lifetime or material.

anchor.space: Follow rider every simulation update for full active duration; camera-aware projection for both supported angles.
anchor.location: Leading edge stays just behind hero silhouette/board rear; not fixed to release location.
anchor.growth: Expand backward and vertically; target bottom at waterline behind rider and top at gameplay viewport ceiling below HUD.

billow.method: Continuously deform existing curls slightly and offset overlapping lobes smoothly with independent phase; no repeated frame toggles.

assembly.source: Reuse existing brown cloud unchanged in three overlapping camera-facing lobes; no need for new raster.
assembly.composition: Adjust three center positions to cover the full target height with no horizontal seams or holes. Stagger trailing edges/scale modestly, keep leading extent behind hero. Bound count to three.
assembly.color: Native warm brown/ochre source color, unshaded; no green tint, gray wash or luminous emission. Maintain dense brown center and translucent billowing perimeter.

animation.pause: Freeze clock and billow while paused; resume without phase jump.

rendering.orientation: Camera-facing lobes sized from projected water-to-gameplay-ceiling extent for each camera angle.
rendering.material: Dedicated super instance parameters; ordinary fidget materials unchanged.
rendering.priority: Behind hero/board and HUD; keep upcoming route on forward side readable. Cosmetic cloud may obscure scenery behind rider.
rendering.clipping: Clip against gameplay viewport below HUD; soft irregular perimeter, no rectangular backing or horizontal fog stripe.
rendering.depth: Root selects depth/composite arrangement that achieves water-to-ceiling coverage without water plane cutting cloud in half. Hero/board retain priority.
rendering.readability: Cloud must remain visibly massive for entire hold and follow hero through movement and camera changes.

lifecycle.end: Expire at8seconds; no offscreen-retirement while active merely because original release point scrolled away. Clear on death/retry/scene teardown.
lifecycle.activation: Use approved super input/charge policy supplied by Engineering; this art contract does not alter counts or cooldown.
lifecycle.safety: No collision, damage, impulse, hop, propulsion, obstacle removal or enemy effect.
